A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same X2-DFD work, with all 15 pages readable, including equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix. The only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original X2-DFD detection results in Tables 1–2, module ablations in Table 3, and feature-capability and human-evaluation results in Figures 6–7.

after.justification: v3 retains the original detection experiments, module ablations, feature-capability analysis, and human evaluation reported in Tables 1–3 and Figures 6–7.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains identical MFA, SFS, WFS, and inference procedures, including feature ranking, LoRA fine-tuning, and integration of external detector scores.

E1.justification: Sections 3 and 5 retain the same dataset and task coverage, including cross-dataset detection, six DF40 face-swapping scenarios, and human evaluation.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Figure 2, Tables 1–2, and the human evaluation. This includes the same conventional detectors and GPT-4o/LLaVA human-evaluation comparators.

E3.justification: Both versions use identical cross-dataset and cross-manipulation protocols, FF++ c23 training, frame/video evaluation, metrics, training settings, and human-evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Table 3's module ablations and Figure 6's feature-capability analysis are identical. No robustness, sensitivity, error-analysis, or case-study evidence is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests; the plots also remain identical.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted results match. For X2-DFD, Table 1 retains average frame/video AUCs of 89.0/91.9, and Table 2 retains average AUC 85.6. Ablation and human-evaluation findings also match.

T1.justification: Equations 1–3 and the formal method expressions in Section 4 are identical. No mathematical definition, assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about assessing MLLM capabilities, strengthening explainability, and integrating external detectors within an extensible framework.

C2.justification: Interpretations of strong versus weak features, generalization, and explainability are unchanged, as are the face-forgery scope restriction and proposed future feedback-loop extension.

D1.justification: Implementation and access information are identical. Section 5.1 retains one NVIDIA 4090, one training epoch, learning rate 2e-5, rank 16, alpha 32, and batch size 4.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works throughout the manuscript, and the references on pages 11–15 are identical. Research positioning and novelty statements remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2, 6 Dec 2024, to v3, 2 May 2025. Manuscript wording, headings, author information, and structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All seven figures, three tables, captions, axes, legends, and placements are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–15 are pixel-identical; the stamp edit does not alter page layout.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information are identical. The sole visible revision updates the arXiv version/date stamp, producing no meaningful improvement or deterioration in paper quality.
